note: Filings kept out of the marginal-rate baseline (dev/validate_v020.clj) and out of the scenario cost model enumeration (dev/scenario_cost_models.py and the clj-urpx side of dev/cross_check_scenario_cost_models.clj) because the pinned clj-urpx cannot resolve them correctly. Each entry names the clj-urpx release that can. Once deps.edn pins that release or later, dev/withheld_filings.py refuses until the entry is removed, which is the prompt to record the filing's baseline cells and regenerate the scenario cost models.
